name: Paper Chain
description: Paper chains hanging in columns, the links in mixed colors, each face-on loop threaded through a narrow edge-on loop to the next.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { -webkit-transform: translateX(@calc(7 * sin(@y * 0.7 + @x * 2.3))%); transform: translateX(@calc(7 * sin(@y * 0.7 + @x * 2.3))%); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 41%; width: 18%; top: -30%; height: 60%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5), var(--color6)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(closest-side, transparent 56%, #000 56%); mask: radial-gradient(closest-side, transparent 56%, #000 56%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 17%; width: 66%; top: 8%; height: 84%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5), var(--color6)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(closest-side, transparent 74%, #000 74%); mask: radial-gradient(closest-side, transparent 74%, #000 74%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
